release: Phase117 OS & Security Support Lifecycle Check
title_ja: 中古スマホ OS・セキュリティサポート確認DB
title_en: Used Smartphone OS & Security Support Lifecycle Check
principles_ja: 残り年数を国内キャリア発売日から逆算しない
主要OS互換・長期更新方針・現在のセキュリティ更新リストを別シグナルとして保持
現行リスト未掲載だけでサポート終了と断定しない
購入可否はPhase115で個体状態と合わせて判断
principles_en: Do not calculate remaining years from Japanese carrier release dates
Keep current-major-OS compatibility, long-term policy and current security cadence as separate signals
Do not treat absence from a current list as proof that support ended
Combine this with individual-unit checks in Phase115 before purchase
